images.01: Samarkand courtyard at golden sunset with blue tiled domes in the distance, a vine-covered tapchan with a dastarkhan of bread, fruit and teapot; a tall American tourist John, 30, ginger hair, freckles, blue cap, sitting cross-legged awkwardly holding a piyola, wide-eyed. Warm gold and turquoise palette, epic composition.
images.02: Close-up of the American tourist John with ginger hair, freckles and blue cap looking sadly and confused at a blue-and-white cotton-pattern piyola only half full of green tea, Uzbek dastarkhan background.
images.03: Young Uzbek woman Zarina, 25, long black braid, burgundy atlas dress with a light cardigan, smiling warmly and explaining with an open hand gesture, sitting on a tapchan in a courtyard with vines.
images.04: Elderly Uzbek man Karim ota, 72, white beard, striped chapan robe and black-white doppi, pouring green tea from a piyola back into a ceramic teapot with a high thin stream, calm wise smile, sunlit courtyard.
images.04_b: SMALL CHANGE: same picture, but the old man now lifts the teapot higher and the tea stream is longer, he winks.
images.05: Still life close-up: blue-and-white Uzbek cotton-pattern teapot and several half-filled piyolas with green tea and steam on a red dastarkhan with non bread, dramatic warm light, dark background.
images.06: The American tourist with ginger hair and blue cap happily holding up an empty piyola while the old Uzbek man in striped chapan pours him more tea, both laughing, courtyard at dusk.
images.07: Night courtyard with string lights: the American tourist with ginger hair leaning back on cushions with a full belly surrounded by many empty piyolas, the old man and young woman laughing, cozy and funny.

hero: amerikalik sayyoh Jon (30, malla soch, sepkil, ko'k kepka) + Karim ota (72, to'n, salla-do'ppi) + qizi Zarina (tarjimon)
